flows:
Navigate to https://mynoise.net/NoiseMachines/whiteNoiseGenerator.php then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
First assert that the Menu icon at the top of the White Noise Generator is in the sequential keyboard focus order.
Use Tab and Enter to open it.
Verify the site navigation opens and the Full Index link is visible.
Keyboard navigation: Once the focusability checkpoint passes, press Tab once from fresh page focus to focus the top Menu icon.
Then press Enter and look for Full Index.
